samples.question: The picture shows one connected teal wire that zigzags between two horizontal levels. A violet ring marks the port at one end of the wire; the wire's other end is bare. Five orange squares and three gray squares sit beside the wire, each separated from it by a visible gap. The gray squares are decoys and mean nothing. Walk along the teal wire starting at the violet ringed port and continue to the bare end, following every bend. Each orange square lies on your left hand or on your right hand as you pass it, judged against the direction you are walking along the piece of wire that that square sits beside. Do you pass more orange squares on your left or more on your right? Answer left or right.
